_comment: EGM Downloader Windows Portable update feed. Upload to egerena.com/apps/egm-portable-version.json
_version_notes: New: Drag the small handle at the top of the links card or the Settings panel to swap their places. The app remembers your choice, and it is included in Export and Import.
Fixed: Small labels, like Format, Video quality, the table headers and the Themes window headings, are clearer and easier to read on many themes.
Fixed: The hint text in the download folder field now follows your theme.
Fixed: The History, Console and Subscriptions pages now match the main window's colors on the default theme.
Fixed: The LIVE tag on a video card is readable on every theme.
Fixed: The format badges in History (MP3, MP4, FLAC and the like) are easier to read on light themes.
Fixed: The Save button in the Theme Creator panel is easier to read.
Fixed: Green buttons, like Stop and save, are easier to read on many themes.

Fixed: 139 themes are easier to read, with clearer labels, hints, status colors and button text. Some accents, surfaces and background patterns also changed, so similar themes look different from each other and text stays clear.

notes: New: Drag the small handle at the top of the links card or the Settings panel to swap their places. The app remembers your choice, and it is included in Export and Import.

Fixed: 139 themes are easier to read, with clearer labels, hints, status colors and button text. Some accents, surfaces and background patterns also changed, so similar themes look different from each other and text stays clear.
Electron runtime updated to v45.2.1.
Fixed: What's New now shows the notes of the version you are running, not the notes of the latest release. It also works without a connection.
Fixed: When a live recording ends on its own, the card now stays on Converting until it is saved, instead of going back to Recording for a moment.
Electron runtime updated to v45.1.0, with an updated Chromium (156.0.8078.49) and Node.js 24.22.1, a security release.
Fixed: The installer edition now starts on a newer Python when an older one comes first on your PC, instead of asking you to install Python 3.11 or newer.
Changed: When the app has to download its own Node.js, it now downloads 24.22.1, a security release. A Node.js 22.12 or newer that is already there is kept.

Security: The minimum curl_cffi version is now 0.17.0, the library that lets the app download from sites that check which browser is asking. It includes the same upstream fix as brotli for how malformed compressed data is handled (CVE-2026-111497).
Updated: The minimum yt-dlp version is now 2026.10.26, the first one that works with curl_cffi 0.17.
Fixed: Installs that were already set up now also get these two minimum versions at start instead of keeping older copies. If the app is offline, it starts normally with what it has.
Fixed: The Subscriptions window keeps showing "Fetching videos..." until the fetch has finished, also when the language loads late or two fetches of the same channel run at once.
Fixed: The Theme Creator panel no longer slides across the window when you switch to or from Arabic.
Fixed: More labels that stayed in English in other languages now follow the selected language.
New: Arabic now reads right to left, with the whole app mirrored.
Changed: The app starts faster on every platform.
Changed: The splash screen was redesigned.
Changed: The What's New button in the footer was replaced by the version number. Click the version number to see what's new.
Fixed: A few buttons and labels that stayed in English in other languages now follow the selected language.
Fixed: The update check never offers an older release as an update.
Fixed: A download that fails partway is no longer reported as saved when only the video part of it was downloaded, and the leftover files are removed.
Fixed: Portable: a rare case where the first launch used Python packages already on your PC instead of its own, which made the next launch noticeably slower while it installed them.

Changed: The installer edition now needs Python 3.11 or newer (it was 3.10). Python 3.10 reached end of life in October 2026 and newer yt-dlp builds no longer support it. The portable edition is not affected.
Security: The minimum brotli version is now 1.2.1, the library that unpacks compressed web responses, which includes an upstream fix for how malformed data is handled (CVE-2026-111497).
Updated: The minimum yt-dlp version is now 2026.10.21, which includes the reworked Kick extractor for Kick downloads.
Fixed: Installs that were already set up now get these minimum versions at start instead of keeping older copies. If the app is offline, it starts normally with what it has.
